title: Stuffed Eggplant Curry
subtitle: with coconut dal
description: Roasted eggplant slices rolled around spiced paneer and spinach, nestled into a coconut red lentil dal and baked until golden. The dal and eggplant can be made a day ahead.

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 220°C and line 2 trays with baking paper. Trim the eggplants and cut lengthways into 6 slices each, 0.5 cm thick.

Toss the eggplant slices with 3 tablespoons olive oil, 3/4 teaspoon salt and a generous pinch of pepper, spread on the trays and bake for 25 minutes until soft and browned, swapping the tray positions after about 12 minutes. Cool.

Make the dal: heat 2 tablespoons olive oil in a deep wide pan over medium-high heat, fry the chopped eschalots for 8 minutes until golden, then add the ginger, half the chilli and half the curry leaves and cook for 2 minutes.

Add the mustard seeds, cumin, ground coriander, turmeric, curry powder, tomato paste and lentils and stir for 1 minute. Add the coconut milk, water and 3/4 teaspoon salt, bring to the boil, lower to medium and cook for 20 minutes until the lentils are soft and the sauce thick. Pour into a 20 x 30 cm baking dish.
Mix the coarsely grated paneer, lime zest, chopped pickled mango, 1 tablespoon lime juice, coriander and a pinch of salt in a bowl.

Place a spinach leaf on each eggplant slice, add a mound of the paneer mixture and roll up from the thin end. Set the rolls seam side down in the dal, pressing gently, and bake for 15 to 20 minutes until golden and the sauce is bubbling. Rest for 5 minutes.

Heat the remaining tablespoon of olive oil in a small pan, fry the remaining chilli and curry leaves for about 1 minute until crisp, then spoon over the eggplant. Drizzle with the remaining lime juice, scatter with coriander and serve.
